results.title: Erin Vasquez — VP, Partnerships | Hollis Group
results.text: Erin Vasquez is Vice President of Partnerships at Hollis Group, where she runs the firm's technology alliances with analytics vendors. She joined Hollis in 2023 after eight years at Brightline Data, where she built its reseller program. She is based in Chicago.
